title: feed.settlement_received
description: Results of a fixture's markets (C05 §7). Published by the feed service on NATS subject evt.feed.settlement_received (version 1); C10 settles the open bets on these outcomes (B7). A later settlement of the same market (after a rollback, or a correction) is a new event with a newer ts_ms. This is the `data` payload; the envelope (event_id, type, version, tenant_id, occurred_at, trace_id) is TD-02 §5. Feed events are global: the envelope's tenant_id is null (B4a plan, decision 5). New fields are additive only.

fixture_id.description: Catalogue fixture ID (opaque; contract fixtures keep the contract's IDs, e.g. fx_arsenal_chelsea)

ts_ms.description: The provider's timestamp of the message, Unix milliseconds; changes apply in this order (FEED-07)

certainty.description: The provider's certainty (1 = live scouts, 2 = confirmed)

outcome_id.description: The outcome ID slips, bets and bookings use

result.description: C10 §4's vocabulary (the slip calculator's results, D1.5)

void_factor.description: 0 for win and lose, 0.5 for half results, 1 for void

dead_heat_factor.description: 1 unless a dead heat; at most 4 decimals (C10 numeric(5,4))
